svg.title: Before and after
svg.desc: Ministral 14B before and after the reliability round. Golden set, 122 questions under the same scoring rules: solved 61% then 71%, wrong answers 24% then 5% of answers given, refusals of answerable questions 5% then 18%. Sealed set, 40 unseen questions run once: solved 55% then 75%, wrong answers 22% then 7%, refusals of answerable questions 0% then 3%.
svg.text: Ministral 14B, before and after the reliability round
